title: Reply with a missing-item status
summary: Fiber: Reply with a missing-item status. Inspect the status too.
introduction: Status selects a code before a body is sent. Open GET /missing.
learningObjectives: Reply with a missing-item status with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Reply with a missing-item status
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/missing", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.Status(404).JSON(fiber.Map{"error": "Book not found"}) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: Status changes the response code before JSON writes the error body.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A helpful error body should keep the correct error status.
